milestones.goal: Widen the public AI engineering evidence: a fixed evaluation set for the reliability contract, a provider-neutral adapter seam and reproducible run artifacts.
Exercise the approval-gated workflow under replay and adversarial conditions while keeping the boundary explicit: no autonomous actions and no external service integration.
Expand product engineering: turn the planned product surface into a public, inspectable MVP rather than a stated intention.
Launch the rebuilt portfolio: replace the legacy static site once the validation battery and the review gate pass.
